points.en: Narrow Money (M1): Currency with public + Demand deposits with banks.
points.hi: Narrow Money (M1): Currency with public + Demand deposits with banks.

points.en: Broad Money (M3): M1 + Time deposits with banks.
points.hi: Broad Money (M3): M1 + Time deposits with banks.

points.en: Liquidity: M1 is most liquid; M3 is least liquid but reflects total money supply.
points.hi: Liquidity: M1 is most liquid; M3 is least liquid but reflects total money supply.

points.en: RBI uses M3 as the primary measure for monetary policy.
points.hi: RBI uses M3 as the primary measure for monetary policy.

explanation.en: Currency (C) plus Demand Deposits (DD) equals the most liquid form of money.
explanation.hi: Currency (C) plus Demand Deposits (DD) equals the most liquid form of money.

misconception.hi: M3 includes all types of deposits.

correction.en: M3 includes demand and time deposits, but excludes inter-bank deposits.
